en-US.title: Expense Tracker - Murmur
en-US.subtitle: Speak your spending
en-US.description:
Murmur is the fastest way to know where your money goes. Say it once and it's filed: "twelve fifty at Chipotle" becomes a categorized expense before your phone is back in your pocket.

No bank logins. No spreadsheets. No forms.

SPEAK, AND IT'S FILED
One tap, one sentence. Murmur hears the amount, the place and the category, in your language, and files it instantly. Income too: say what you earned and it lands on the right side of the ledger.

PAY, AND IT CAPTURES ITSELF
Set up one Shortcuts automation (Murmur walks you through it) and every purchase you make with your iPhone's wallet logs itself: amount, merchant, logo and category, with a quiet notification you can edit in one tap. Even pay-at-pump purchases that report no amount get parked and resolved, never lost.

SEE THE MONTH CLEARLY
Insights shows what you spent, how it compares to last month, where it went by category, and highlights that matter: an upcoming bill, a budget running hot, a purchase that is 8x your usual.

BUDGETS AND RECURRING
Set a budget and watch the daily pace. Recurring bills and income are first-class: Murmur knows what is coming and what is left after it.

ASK MURMUR (PLUS)
Ask anything about your own numbers: "how am I doing against my budget?", "what should I cancel?" Answers come from your data, instantly.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Murmur never connects to your bank. Your voice is turned into text on your phone whenever the device supports it, and audio is never stored. Export everything or erase everything, anytime.

EVERYWHERE YOU ARE
Murmur syncs across iPhone and the web dashboard at itsmurmur.com. Murmur Plus adds the Mac and Windows apps.

MURMUR PLUS
Everything above is free. Murmur Plus adds Ask Murmur, automatic recurring detection, exports (CSV, JSON, PDF) and the Mac and Windows apps. Monthly or yearly, both with a 7-day free trial. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends, and are managed in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Service: https://itsmurmur.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://itsmurmur.com/privacy
en-US.promoText: One sentence and it's filed. Tap to pay and it captures itself. Murmur keeps your money story between you and your phone.

review.notes: DEMO ACCOUNT: on the sign-in screen tap 'More options' to reveal the email form, then sign in with the credentials above. The account is pre-loaded with sample transactions and a budget, so Today, Insights and Budgets all show data. CORE FLOW: tap the mic on the Today tab and say e.g. 'fifteen dollars at Starbucks'; the expense files itself. Speech is transcribed by the device (on-device recognition is requested); Murmur never records or transmits audio. ACCOUNT DELETION (guideline 5.1.1(v)): Settings > Account > Delete account, and also Settings > Privacy Center > Your data. One confirmation, then the account and every record attached to it are permanently deleted server-side and the app signs out. DATA EXPORT: Settings > Privacy Center > Export all my data. THIRD-PARTY AI: Murmur sends text to OpenAI through our own server to interpret spoken entries and scanned receipts (gpt-4o-mini) and to answer Ask Murmur (gpt-4o). Sent: the transcribed sentence or the scanned image, and for Ask Murmur the user's own transactions, recurring rules, income figure, currency, time zone and question. Never sent: name, email, account id, device ids, location. Murmur never connects to a bank. Disclosed at https://itsmurmur.com/privacy. SUBSCRIPTION: Murmur Plus (auto-renewable, 7-day free trial) under Settings > Subscription; it unlocks Ask Murmur (More > Ask Murmur), recurring detection, exports and the desktop apps. Everything else is included without a subscription. WALLET CAPTURE is an optional Shortcuts automation the user creates themselves from Settings; it is not needed to review the app. The app is iPhone-only and runs in compatibility mode on iPad.
